entries.title: Jeremiah 27:1
segments: Jehoiakim; many suppose that this should read, "Zedekiah," as in

For the accomplishment of his own ends, God sometimes intrusts wicked and impious rulers with great power and authority; and then all resistance on the part of the neighboring nations proves vain.  But when he has fulfilled his purposes by them, he humbles them as easily as he had before exalted them.  Compare
